title: 群星应答

selectedMaster.selection: 人工首检：上方仅一位半透明星空天使，横展双翼和单一银白号角清晰；连续弧形观测台与近栏完整，台上恰好五人和一犬均可逐一辨认且犬有稳定立足面。未做透明、细部或倾斜验收。

generationRuns.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: 1024×1536 selected master artwork for a vertical Tarot v2 holographic-card project.
Input image: the immediately previous displayed Judgement tarot original is a composition/identity reference only.
Primary request: Create the theme “群星应答” (Answering Stars), a finished vertical painterly fantasy Tarot master, no printed title or border. Exactly one semi-transparent starry celestial angel occupies the upper area, displaying exactly two horizontally spread, clearly distinct wings and sounding exactly one silver-white trumpet. The angel’s night-purple robe, dark transparent folds, and shaded interiors of both wings remain clearly visible; no overexposed white silhouette. On one broad, continuous, solid crescent-shaped astronomical observation platform across the lower third, exactly five human figures stand arranged along the arc with exactly one clearly visible dog at its own stable footing. Preserve the complete platform, near brass railing, and all contact shadows. Beyond it is a deep violet star-sea, with a delicate pale-gold path of light opening into the distance.
Scene/backdrop: serene observatory platform above a cosmic sea, sparse stars, no city or landscape repeats.
Style/medium: highly detailed luminous painterly fantasy illustration, refined tarot art.
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3, horizontal angel wings in upper zone; five humans in lower arc, dog clearly visible and separate; full continuous platform safely inside frame.
Lighting/mood: nocturnal wonder, gentle rose-gold starlight and silver illumination, natural skin tones.
Color palette: night violet, silver white, restrained rose gold.
Constraints: exactly one angel, exactly two wings, exactly one trumpet; exactly five humans, exactly one dog; one continuous observation platform and near railing, no duplicate platforms, no cropped feet, no extra people/animals/angels/trumpets, no text, no lettering, no border, no watermark, no checkerboard.
